clean_data: forward days after registration only, real NQ futures bars from the nightly archive (sessions >= 2026-10-23)

futility.evaluated_on: exactly the first L forward trades (chronological) at look L
futility.calibration: same rule as F10 (CP < 1% at 100/200/300 trades), alternative = F13's own validation edge

validation.note: F13 forward variant 2022-now; same mechanism as F10 -> half weight

posterior.forward: mean R per trade with variance sd^2/n, sd = max(sample sd, 1.5)

cusum_kill.series: daily R summed over each forward trade day (days without trades skipped)
cusum_kill.calibration: variant 2 trade days 2022-now recentred to +0.049R/trade; ARL ~3 years

note: F13 did NOT qualify on the fast-track speed metric (best $26/month per account); forward-tested for information only, never counted as a confirmation independent of F10.
